experiment_name: Conformal Test-Martingale Drift Detection + Adaptive Recalibration

methodology.framework: Split Conformal Prediction + Sequential Power Test-Martingale

E2_abrupt_drift.schedule: Batches 1-10: Reference (5% fraud); Batches 11-20: Shifted (25% fraud, elevated risk scores)

E3_gradual_drift.schedule: Batches 1-5: 100% ref; Batches 6-10: 75% ref + 25% shifted; Batches 11-15: 50% ref + 50% shifted; Batches 16-20: 25% ref + 75% shifted

E4_adversarial_gen2_drift.schedule: Batches 1-10: Reference; Batches 11-20: Gen-2 evolved/mutated adversarial attacks

systems_under_test.name: Static Conformal
systems_under_test.description: Calibrated once on reference set N=2000; never recalibrates

systems_under_test.name: Oracle Adaptive
systems_under_test.description: Recalibrates at predetermined drift point using most recent 500 eligible delayed labels

systems_under_test.name: Drift-Aware Adaptive
systems_under_test.description: Sequential conformal test-martingale detection; recalibrates upon alarm using delayed labels
